title: Let Everything That Has Breath Praise the Lord

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Praise God in his what?
Praise him in his mighty what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:1 (ESV): "praise him in his mighty heavens!"

questions.question: Praise him for his mighty what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:2 (ESV): "Praise him for his mighty deeds;"

questions.question: Praise him according to his excellent what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:2 (ESV): "praise him according to his excellent greatness!"

questions.question: Praise him with trumpet sound; praise him with lute and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:3 (ESV): "praise him with lute and harp!"

questions.question: Praise him with tambourine and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:4 (ESV): "Praise him with tambourine and dance;"

questions.question: Praise him with strings and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:4 (ESV): "praise him with strings and pipe!"

questions.question: Praise him with loud clashing what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:5 (ESV): "praise him with loud clashing cymbals!"

questions.question: Let everything that has breath do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:6 (ESV): "Let everything that has breath praise the Lord!"

questions.question: Where is God to be praised according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalm 150:1 (ESV): "Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens!"

questions.question: This Psalm serves as the concluding doxology to what?
questions.explanation: It is the grand finale of the Psalter.

questions.question: How many different types of instruments are mentioned (grouping lute/harp)?
questions.explanation: Trumpet, lute, harp, tambourine, strings, pipe, cymbals.

questions.question: The call to praise is for whom/what?

key_verse_text: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
